description: This file contains Python source code defining functions for managing a to-do list database using SQLite. It includes functions for initializing the database, creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks, with an emphasis on database interactions and task management logic.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection _get_connection()
methods.description: Creates and returns a SQLite database connection with row factory set to return rows as dictionaries.

methods.name: None init_db()
methods.description: Initializes the database by creating the 'tasks' table if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(title: str, completed: bool = False)
methods.description: Creates a new task entry in the database with given title and completion status.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_tasks()
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the database, ordered by id descending.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task(task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by id, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Updates the title and/or completion status of a specified task, returning the updated task.

methods.name: bool delete_task(task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task by id, returning True if successful.

ctags.name: create_task
ctags.pattern: /^def create_task(title: str, completed: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_task
ctags.pattern: /^def update_task(task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None) -> /
ctags.signature: (task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None)
